mechanism: Valproic acid may increase liraglutide exposure through protein binding displacement and potential inhibition of glucuronidation pathways, while liraglutide's gastrointestinal effects may alter valproic acid absorption.
action: Monitor serum valproic acid levels and clinical efficacy; adjust valproic acid dosing if needed and counsel on gastrointestinal side effects that may affect anticonvulsant absorption.
